answer.title: BYD Marketing Campaign Strategy in Malaysia

lead.text: BYD's current marketing strategy in Malaysia centers on launch events, roadshows, and rebate campaigns.

sentences.text: BYD ran the Merdeka Dreams Deal rebate campaign in August 2026.
The Merdeka campaign offered up to RM14,000 off the Atto 3 and up to RM7,000 off the Sealion 7.
The 2026 BYD SEALION 7 launch event occurred on 14th November.
The 2026 BYD ATTO 3 launch event took place from 5–7 June 2026 at XOX Arena, The Arch Galeries, Kuala Lumpur.
BYD Tech Discovery 2025 roadshow was held recently.
A Shark 6 preview occurred at the roadshow.
BYD Malaysia offered a free RM800 charging credit at the Malaysia Autoshow 2025.
BYD prioritizes urban areas with higher EV adoption rates and developed charging infrastructure.
Millennials and Gen Z are significant targets due to their environmental consciousness and tech-savviness.
These targeting claims are from 2024 and may be stale.
BYD brand year-to-date sales reached 11,097 units as of Nov 2025.
Combined BYD and Denza sales reached 24,328 units as of Nov 2025.
BYD delivered 1,000 units of the BYD ATTO 3 within the first 100 days of the Malaysian launch.

not_found: Number of people attracted to specific recent BYD campaigns or events.
Information on whether the Merdeka Dreams Deal campaign has ended or its specific end date.
